description: Implementation of HttpProxyClientSocket class handling HTTP proxy connections, including authentication, request/response parsing, and connection management.

classes.name: HttpProxyClientSocket
classes.description: Handles HTTP proxy connection including authentication, request/response parsing, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: HttpProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy socket with parameters like socket, user agent, endpoint, proxy server, auth controller, delegate, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Restarts the connection process with authentication.

methods.name: GetConnectResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the response info after connection.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes the connection, handling proxy authentication if needed.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket and resets state.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN was negotiated; always false for tunneled connection.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol; always unknown.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL info; always false for tunneled connection.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Reads data if socket is ready.

methods.name: PrepareForAuthRestart
methods.description: Prepares socket for restart with proxy auth, draining body if needed.

methods.name: DidDrainBodyForAuthRestart
methods.description: Completes draining body and prepares for auth restart.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Runs the user callback with result.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles IO completion and continues loop.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main state machine loop for connection process.

methods.name: DoSendRequest
methods.description: Sends HTTP CONNECT request to proxy.

methods.name: DoReadHeadersComplete
methods.description: Processes response headers and handles proxy responses.

methods.name: CheckDone
methods.description: Checks if connection process is complete.
